correctness.rationale: Exact induction shows u_n=T^{floor(log2(n+1))}(x); v_j=T^j(x) repeats 2^j times. Piecewise affine Φ(y)=4/5-y/5 obeys y+Φ(y)<=2Φ(Ty) on [0,1], equality on right tent branch. Telescoping with 2^-j weights gives B_K<=Φ(v_K)-2^-K Φ(x), then interpolation inside each block yields sum_{n<N}u_n<=(4N+x)/5. Upper sharpness: legal right-branch backward orbit z_-j=(2/3)(1-(-1/2)^j) has discounted average sum 2^-j z_-j=4/5; a dense forward orbit shadows arbitrarily long finite reversed segments at arbitrarily late times. Lower sharpness: arbitrary late shadowing of fixed point 0. Cesaro increments <=1/(N+1) ensure all intermediate limit points, and full tent Lebesgue ergodic map yields almost sure density and ordinary mean1/2. Independently checked rational sample recurrence and upper bound and geometric inverse branch sums. Finite verify.py tests not proof for every real x.
